title: Red Shoes
tagline: A game that incorporates other NFT sneakers and makes them playable
description:
# Why do we build this?

Many brands are spending a lot of money to migrate into web3, buy land, and create virtual world. For those already here,  most NFT sneakers are just a JPEG or wearable to walk around.

We want to help more and more brands step into web3 and make these NFT sneakers playable and rewarding.


# How do we make it happen?

We transform the NFT sneakers into our in-game asset, so players can wear and even compete with them. The game can give utility to the NFT, and the competition is a great way to bring brand exposure.

# Our vision?

Give utility to more and more NFT sneakers, and connect more WEB2 sneaker brands to WEB3
how_its_made:
# POLYGON  
[1] Smart contracts deployed on @polygon. Deploy three smart contracts on Polygon Mumbai and mainnet, one for NFT mint and stake, two for @Superfluid     
  
 # OPTIMISM     
[2] Smart contracts are also deployed on @Optimism mainnet
   

[3] Game developed with Unreal Engine5,  avatar was created in Metahuman system and also uses these assets: Manilaland, Thirdpersion, Mixamo
 
# SUPERFLUID     
[4] Stake and get coins by @superfluid When a player stakes NFT, superfluid will generate in-game coins over time. these coins are the major in-game currency


# TABLELAND  
[5]Thanks to Tableland, It makes important game props bound with NFT forever.  We use tableland to manage constantly changing metadata, such as the achievements or battling history of the NFT  

# IPFS   
[6] NFT image storage in @IPFS 

# NFTPORT  
[7] We use @NFTPort's API to retrieve contract NFTs when on POLYGON mainnet

# EPNS  
[8] @EPNS Bring governance information to users,  every time a player is qualified to receive the award, we will send a message by EPNS  

# WORLDCOIN  
[9] We use @Worldcoin to make sure every player is a human when they redeem reward
